parole.significato: Any member of the species Marmota sibirica of marmots that live on the steppes of Central Asia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian тарбаган (tarbagan), from Southern Altai (Teleut) тарбаган (tarbagan), ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *tarbagan.

parole.significato: A plucked two-string lute traditionally used by the Altai people.
parole.testo: Borrowing from Russian топшу́р (topšúr), from Southern Altai топшуур (topšuur).
